description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case and a short white charging cable. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp and lift the AirPods case, while the right hand moves in from the right to pick up the cable end and bring it to the bottom of the case; the right hand aligns and plugs the connector in, then both hands lower the case back onto the bed with the cable attached.
